appearance_facts.fact: A scatter-style chart titled 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' displays six blue circular markers, each with a percentage label directly above it.
Categories appear in order: Service Quality, Service Cost, Service Design, Support Access, Service Delivery, Other.
The Service Design marker (labeled 12%) is the lowest point on the chart, sitting below all other markers including Support Access (17%) and Other (41%).

printed_facts.fact: Public Service Feedback Share by Category

public_definitions: Select the service category that should enter the low-feedback coverage follow-up workflow.
